notes.title: Announcing Delicards - The Delicious Card Game
notes.content:
[b]Delivoo - The Delicious Card Game[/b]
[i]Development & Release Plan[/i]

I am super excited to have launched this page, along with the [url=https://discord.gg/HpTGvmQHXy]Discord[/url] channel. Releasing this game has been a dream of mine since early on, as I love Trading Card Games (especially to collect rare and legendary cards) and, ofcourse, cooking!

The plan is to have an [b]Early Access Release [/b] sometime in [i]December 2023[/i], following a full release in [i]March 2024[/i].

This is a solo project in which I have invested a lot of passion and love for making games and I want each part of the game to reflect this, that's why I don't want to rush the release, but polish it as best as I can.

The supported platforms are[b] PC, Mac (Intel and M1/Arm) and SteamOS[/b] with consoles being planned for later next year.

[b]Get Involved[/b]
[i]International Contributions[/i]

Since the game focuses on cooking, there is a high variety of recipes and ingredients from all around the world. 

Wherever you might be located, you know some local dishes that waters your mouth and brings in that [u]UMAMI[/u] experience. 

I want to incorporate as much of international cuisine as possible and don't want to miss out any of the golden "[i]granny[/i]" recipes you know, so please join the [url=https://discord.gg/HpTGvmQHXy]Discord[/url] server and post it under card-ideas channel. Your effort will be rewarded with your name being stated as the [i]card author.[/i]

Also, I'm planning to post frequent updates on the progress of the game on the server, so feel free to join and participate in polls, closed betas and play-tests early on (together with contests in which you might win a Steam key).

[b]The 20 updates 'till launch strategy[/b]
[i]The way I see it[/i]

I'm planning to publish 20 of these Steam updates before the full game release (excluding this one). Each of them will mark a major milestone in the game design and development process I'm working through. 

Thank you for reading all this - hope you wishlist the game, join the Discord community, tell your friends about it and, most of all, look forward to the launch as much as I do!
